cues: Push current the other way with an outside source, and you drive a non spontaneous reaction.
That is an electrolytic cell, used for electroplating and extracting sodium and aluminium.
Notice: oxidation is always at the anode and reduction always at the cathode.
text: Push current the other way with an outside source, and you drive a non spontaneous reaction. That is an electrolytic cell, used for electroplating and extracting sodium and aluminium. Notice: oxidation is always at the anode and reduction always at the cathode. Only the signs swap.
